deskyard logout: revoke this CLI's credential and forget the server

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] logout [SERVER]

Revokes this CLI's credential on the server (default: the default server),
then forgets the server. A credential the server already refuses is forgotten
too; when the server can't be reached, nothing is forgotten.

Arguments:
  SERVER     string      optional  server name (see `deskyard server list`)

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard logout
  deskyard logout work

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
